I’ll be fifty year old, come September, and I hain’t never married one of ’em yit.” “I hain’t never goin’ to marry, neither.” “Shake,” said Tubal.

arxiv-2203-13915.title: Sensitivity of non-radiative cloud-wind interactions to the hydrodynamics solver 2023 Sensitivity of non-radiative cloud-wind interactions to the hydrodynamics solver – 12
arxiv-2203-13915.creator: Joey Braspenning, Joop Schaye, Josh Borrow, Matthieu Schaller
arxiv-2203-13915.description: Abstract Cloud-wind interactions are common in the interstellar and circumgalactic media. Many studies have used simulations of such interactions to investigate the effect of particular physical processes, but the impact of the choice of hydrodynamics solver has largely been overlooked.

arxiv-2204-01124.title: Measurements of one-point statistics in 21 cm intensity maps via foreground avoidance strategy 2019 Measurements of one-point statistics in 21 cm intensity maps via foreground avoidance strategy – References
arxiv-2204-01124.creator: Piyanat Kittiwisit, Judd D. Bowman, Steven G. Murray, Bharat K. Gehlot, Daniel C. Jacobs and Adam P. Beardsley
arxiv-2204-01124.description: Abstract Measurements of the one-point probability distribution function and higher-order moments (variance, skewness, and kurtosis) of the high-redshift 21 cm fluctuations are among the most direct statistical probes of the non-Gaussian nature of structure formation and evolution during reionization. However, contamination from astrophysical foregrounds and instrument systematics pose significant challenges in measuring these statistics in real observations.

arxiv-2206-00969.title: High-dimensional entanglement for quantum communication in the frequency domain
arxiv-2206-00969.creator: Meritxell Cabrejo-Ponce, André Luiz Marques Muniz, Marcus Huber, Fabian Steinlechner
arxiv-2206-00969.description: Abstract High-dimensional photonic entanglement is a promising candidate for error-protected quantum information processing with improved capacity. Encoding high-dimensional qudits in the carrier frequency of photons combines ease of generation, universal single-photon gates, and compatibility with fiber transmission for high-capacity quantum communication.

arxiv-2210-00542.title: Decomposition solutions and Bäcklund transformations of the BKP and CKP equations
arxiv-2210-00542.creator: Xiazhi Hao 1 and S. Y. Lou 2
arxiv-2210-00542.description: Abstract In this paper, we define the modified formal variable separation approach and show how it determines, in a remarkably simple manner, the decomposition solutions, the Bäcklund transformations, the Lax pair, and the linear superposition solution of the B-type Kadomtsev-Petviashvili equation.

arxiv-2301-08295.title: Polar Coded Merkle Tree: Mitigating Data Availability Attacks in Blockchain Systems Using Informed Polar Code Design
arxiv-2301-08295.creator: Debarnab Mitra, Lev Tauz, and Lara Dolecek
arxiv-2301-08295.description: Abstract Data availability (DA) attack is a well-known problem in certain blockchains where users accept an invalid block with unavailable portions. Previous works have used LDPC and 2-D Reed Solomon (2D-RS) codes with Merkle trees to mitigate DA attacks. These codes perform well across various metrics such as DA detection probability and communication cost.

arxiv-2302-08120.title: Generalised Uncertainty Relations from Finite-Accuracy Measurements
arxiv-2302-08120.description: Abstract In this short note we show how the Generalised Uncertainty Principle (GUP) and the Extended Uncertainty Principle (EUP), two of the most common generalised uncertainty relations proposed in the quantum gravity literature, can be derived within the context of canonical quantum theory, without the need for modified commutation relations.

arxiv-2401-04177.title: Evidence for Intrinsic X-ray Weakness Among Red Quasars at Cosmic Noon Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2401-04177.creator: Yilun Ma (马逸伦), Andy Goulding, Jenny E. Greene, Nadia L. Zakamska, Dominika Wylezalek, Yan-Fei Jiang (姜燕飞)
arxiv-2401-04177.description: Abstract Quasar feedback is a key ingredient in shaping galaxy evolution. A rare population of extremely red quasars (ERQs) at z = 2 − 3 z=2-3 are often associated with high-velocity [O iii ] λ ​ 5008 \lambda 5008 outflows and may represent sites of strong feedback.

arxiv-2405-11805.title: The Geometry of Tangent Spaces on Causal Sets
arxiv-2405-11805.creator: Samuel Shuman
arxiv-2405-11805.description: Abstract In this paper, we expand on previous work describing partial derivatives and metric component estimators to define tangent spaces on causal sets. Partial derivative operators are the basis vectors of the tangent space, and the metric defines the inner product.

arxiv-2408-03995.title: γ \gamma -Cascade V4: A Semi-Analytical Code for Modeling Cosmological Gamma-Ray Propagation
arxiv-2408-03995.creator: Antonio Capanema, Carlos Blanco
arxiv-2408-03995.description: Abstract Since the universe is not transparent to gamma rays with energies above around one hundred GeV, it is necessary to account for the interaction of high-energy photons with intergalactic radiation fields in order to model gamma-ray propagation. Here, we present a public numerical software for the modeling of gamma-ray observables.

arxiv-2408-10025.title: The contribution of new physics on the exclusive W boson hadronic decays in the final state at muon colliders in the Randall-Sundrum model
arxiv-2408-10025.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by . An attempt is made to present the effect of new physics in the exclusive decays of W boson at high energy colliders in the Randall-Sundrum (RS) model. By using Feynman diagram techniques we have evaluated the influence of the scalar unparticle, polarization and anomalous couplings on the exclusive W boson hadronic decays of W ± → π ± ​ γ W^{\pm}\rightarrow\pi^{\pm}\gamma , W ± → K ± ​ γ W^{\pm}\rightarrow K^{\pm}\gamma and W ± → ρ ± ​ γ W^{\pm}\rightarrow\rho^{\pm}\gamma at the high

arxiv-2412-10424.title: LLM-as-an-Interviewer : Beyond Static Testing Through Dynamic LLM Evaluation
arxiv-2412-10424.creator: Eunsu Kim, Juyoung Suk, Seungone Kim, Niklas Muennighoff, Dongkwan Kim, Alice Oh
arxiv-2412-10424.description: Abstract We introduce LLM-as-an-Interviewer , a novel paradigm for evaluating large language models (LLMs). This approach leverages multi-turn interactions where the LLM interviewer actively provides feedback on responses and poses follow-up questions to the evaluated LLM. At the start of the interview, the LLM interviewer dynamically modifies datasets to generate initial questions, mitigating data contamination.

europmc-pmc7778599.description: Aims: Ischemia-reperfusion injury (IRI)-induced acute kidney injury (IRI-AKI) is characterized by elevated levels of reactive oxygen species (ROS), mitochondrial dysfunction, and inflammation, but the potential link among these features remains unclear. In this study, we aimed t

pmc-10695950.title: Effectiveness of VSV vectored SARS-CoV-2 spike when administered through intranasal, intramuscular or a combination of both
pmc-10695950.creator: Saina Beitari, Gerard Agbayani, Melissa Hewitt, Diana Duque, Jegarubee Bavananthasivam, Jagdeep K. Sandhu, Bassel Akache, Ita Hadžisejdić, Anh Tran
pmc-10695950.description: A critical feature of the VSV vector platform is the ability to pseudotype the virus with different glycoproteins from other viruses, thus altering cellular tropism of the recombinant virus. The route of administration is critical in triggering local and systemic immune response and protection. Most of the vaccine platforms used at the forefront are administered by intramuscular injection.

pmc-11300998.title: The DAWN antivirals trial: process evaluation of a COVID-19 trial in general practice
pmc-11300998.creator: Dajana Tare, Samuel Coenen, An De Sutter, Stefan Heytens, Dirk Devroey, Laetitia Buret, Birgitte Schoenmakers, Nicolas Delvaux, Jan Y Verbakel, Kris Bogaerts, Ann van den Bruel
pmc-11300998.description: BackgroundThe DAWN antivirals trial was a multicentric, randomised placebo-controlled trial evaluating antiviral medication for COVID-19 in general practice. The trial was prematurely terminated because of insufficient recruitment.AimTo explore which factors contributed to the premature termination.Design & settingGeneral practice in Belgium.

pmc-11397464.title: Aminoethoxyvinylglicine and 1-Methylcyclopropene: Effects on Preharvest Drop, Fruit Maturity, Quality, and Associated Gene Expression of ‘Honeycrisp’ Apples in the US Mid-Atlantic
pmc-11397464.creator: Emily Johnson, Macarena Farcuh, Dongliang Qiu, Caihong Zhong
pmc-11397464.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Preharvest fruit drop is one of the main challenges in apple production as it can lead to extensive crop losses in commercially important cultivars including ‘Honeycrisp’. Plant growth regulators, such as aminoethoxyvinylglicine (AVG) and 1-methylcyclopropene (1-MCP), which hinder ethylene biosynthesis and perception, respectively, can control preharvest fruit drop, but an assessment of their effects in ‘Honeycrisp’ fruit grown under US mid-Atlantic conditions is lacking. In this study, we evaluated the effects of AVG (130 mg a.i. L−1) and 1-MCP (150 mg a.i.

pmc-11569917.title: Association between oral health and hyperuricemia in Korean adults: Korea National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey 2016–2019
pmc-11569917.creator: Junyong Park, Minkook Son, Sung Won Lee, Won Tae Chung, Sang Yeob Lee
pmc-11569917.description: Background/AimsHyperuricemia plays an essential role in the gout. Despite the clinical significance of hyperuricemia, a direct relationship between oral health and hyperuricemia has not been established. We aim to investigate the association between oral health and hyperuricemia.MethodsWe selected 17,557 subjects from the Korea National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey database for the years 2016–2019.

pmc-11712922.title: Whispered Struggles in the Workplace: A Scoping Review of Cognitive and Interpersonal Challenges and Organizational Strategies for Employees living with Dementia
pmc-11712922.creator: Shruti Jindal, Sabrina Pit, Mohammad Hamiduzzaman
pmc-11712922.description: BackgroundDementia, including its younger‐onset variant, increasingly challenges diverse workplaces, affecting both employees living with dementia and their employers. With a growing global trend of individuals extending their working years, it becomes crucial to understand the specific challenges and implications for those with dementia within various employment contexts.

pmc-12458755.title: Evaluating the prognostic association between race and perineal trauma: a systematic review protocol
pmc-12458755.creator: Haifa Hussein Almalki, Fabrice I Mowbray, Susan Buchholz, Ibtihal Alnaimi, Emma C Schlegel, Janis Miller, Jessica Sender
pmc-12458755.description: IntroductionPerineal trauma is one of the most common complications of childbirth, impacting approximately 9 out of 10 women who undergo a vaginal delivery. Perineal trauma is a public health issue leading to increased maternal morbidity and decreased quality of life.

pmc-12542386.title: The impact of using “teaching, exercising, and practicing” three-step training mode on the performance and satisfaction of internship nursing students in the training of fall prevention education ability: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-12542386.creator: Jie Yang, Tianyang Mao, Li Zhou, Ningying Li, Hongyan Wu, Qiaoling Wang, Yangyang Zeng, Ke Liu, Juan Zhou, Jun Wang, Bing Chen
pmc-12542386.description: BackgroundClinical internships are a crucial component of nursing education, offering students the opportunity to apply theoretical knowledge in a clinical setting. Patient falls represent a common issue in hospitals and are a central focus of patient safety management. Enhancing nursing students’ proficiency in fall prevention education during their internships is essential for advancing patient safety and improving future care quality.

pmc-13081464.title: Current practices and perceptions of ChatGPT in gynecologic oncology: results from a cross-sectional questionnaire (TRSGO-AI-001)
pmc-13081464.creator: İbrahim Yalçın, Salih Taşkın, Gözde Şahin, Faruk Köse, Fırat Ortaç, Esra Bilir
pmc-13081464.description: BackgroundWe aimed to assess current practices, perceptions, and perceived effectiveness of ChatGPT among gynecologic oncology professionals in academic and clinical settings.MethodsA 23-item, international online survey was conducted between July and September 2025. Gynecologic oncology professionals were recruited via social media and snowball sampling. We evaluated demographics, awareness, utilization, and perceptions of ChatGPT-3.5 across different domains.

pmc-13184785.title: Pharmacist Outreach and SGLT2 Inhibitor Uptake in Patients With Diabetes and Chronic Kidney Disease
pmc-13184785.creator: Deborah L. Pestka, Daniel Murphy, Adam N. Kaplan, Brent C. Taylor, Pearl Huynh, Jessica A. Rechtzigel, Shari Kjos, Lisa Marie Ellich, Melissa Atwood, Beth A. Polsfuss, Amber R. Thomas, Joseph Y. Lee, Areef Ishani
pmc-13184785.description: This quality improvement study investigates whether pharmacist-led outreach is associated with improved uptake of sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitor medication among patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) and type 2 diabetes. Introduction Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is a common condition affecting nearly 15% of adults in the US,1 and it contributes substantially to morbidity, mortality, and health care costs.

pmc-13194296.title: Ensemble Optimal Control for Managing Drug Resistance in Cancer Therapies
pmc-13194296.creator: Alessandro Scagliotti, Federico Scagliotti, Laura Deborah Locati, Federico Sottotetti
pmc-13194296.description: In this paper, we explore the application of ensemble optimal control to derive enhanced strategies for pharmacological cancer treatment, and we tackle the problem of the long-term management of the disease, i.e., when the complete eradication of the tumor is not achievable.

pmc-13273588.title: A modified coupled partial differential equation method for synthetic aperture sonar interferogram denoising
pmc-13273588.creator: Pan Huang, Yan Fan, Meng Wang, Lijie Guo
pmc-13273588.description: SummaryInterferometric synthetic aperture sonar (InSAS), a new high-resolution three-dimensional imaging device, is broadly utilized in underwater exploration. Interferogram noise removal is a necessary stage in InSAS image processing. The coupled partial differential equation (CPDE)-based method has been frequently used for image denoising.

pmc-13345050.title: Magnetic Resonance Imaging-based Prostate Cancer Diagnosis Using Principal Component Analysis and Machine Learning Algorithms
pmc-13345050.creator: N. Samta, C. S. Sureka, Sivananthan Sarasanandarajah, R. K. Jeevanram
pmc-13345050.description: Purpose:Prostate cancer is a leading cause of cancer-related mortality among men, necessitating accurate and early diagnostic methods. This study evaluates the effectiveness of principal component analysis (PCA) combined with machine learning (ML) for classifying benign and malignant prostate lesions using magnetic resonance imaging (MRI).Materials and Methods:MRI data from 26 biopsy-confirmed prostate cancer patients were obtained from The Cancer Imaging Archive.

pmc-13453926.title: Preventing overfilling of blood bags to reduce clot formation and improve donor safety
pmc-13453926.creator: Kabiru M Sulaiman, Halima Ismail, Yahaya Yazid Ibrahim, Kathleen Selleng, Aisha K Gwarzo, Dalhat Gwarzo, Andreas Greinacher
pmc-13453926.description: Background and ObjectivesOverfilling of blood bags is common in low‐resource settings, causing clot formation, donor and recipient risks and blood wastage. This study assessed overfilling prevalence and evaluated a low‐cost intervention to mitigate it.Materials and MethodsWe conducted a prospective study across six blood banks in Kano, Nigeria, weighing 131 blood bags and examining clot formation in 688 consecutive units.

pmc-13617814.title: Exploring 24-h movement behaviors in preschool children with developmental disabilities: a scoping review
pmc-13617814.creator: Serena Cacciola, Sarah Burkart, Eric Toole, Melissa N. Horger, Ashley C. Woodman, Keagan Kiely, Megan Fisher, Erin Johnson, Gianna Salvati, Liz Rosas, Sarah Freedman, Marie Fandy, Christine W. St. Laurent
pmc-13617814.description: IntroductionUnderstanding how 24-h movement behaviors (i.e., physical activity, sedentary behavior, sleep) differ among children with developmental disabilities (e.g., delays, disorders, disabilities) is crucial, with evidence indicating that variations seen in older children may begin to emerge in early childhood. However, reviews have not acknowledged such developmental considerations in young participants.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel.
